arStrings.szText: "Step inside, young ne'er-do-well, and welcome to the fold. For one of His you shall become, in death or partner in gold.
Grinning, playful, sinister. (Can be sung like a sea shanty or recited in verse.)
So follow your fetid predecessors, their bones do point the way. The Hooklatch awaits your pleasure, it's best you don't delay."
Grinning, playful, sinister. (Can be sung like a sea shanty or recited in verse.)
